newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon has $786.4 mln BoP surplus in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon has $786.4 mln BoP surplus in 1996.

text.p: Lebanon's balance of payments surplus more than tripled in 1996 to $786.4 million from $256 million at the end of 1995, the Bank of Lebanon said in its latest monthly bulletin on Tuesday.
"This surplus in the balance of payments is due to sustained net capital inflows that covered the trade deficit which amounted $6,540 million," the Bank said.
A substantial part of the inflows came from eurobond issues placed on the international markets by Lebanon's leading banks in 1996.
